name: openkk
description: オープン会計 — open-source double-entry bookkeeping library for sole proprietors. Hexagonal architecture with swappable backend and storage adapters.
author: rbdog <rbdog@rubydog.jp>

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run build:packages && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.check:generated: npm run check:master-data && npm run check:service-workers && npm run check:dependency-graph && npm run check:theme-docs && npm run check:icons
scripts.check:full: npm run audit:production && npm run check:generated && npm run check && npm run build:apps && npm run test:e2e:export:built && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build:packages: npm run clean:packages && npm run build -w @rubydogjp/openkk-driver -w @rubydogjp/openkk-engine -w @rubydogjp/openkk-frontend-ui -w @rubydogjp/openkk-backend-api -w @rubydogjp/openkk-sqlite-db-adapter -w @rubydogjp/openkk-memory-db-adapter -w @rubydogjp/openkk-disk-db-adapter -w @rubydogjp/openkk-book-db-adapter -w @rubydogjp/openkk-books-db-adapter -w @rubydogjp/openkk-legacy-db-adapter -w @rubydogjp/openkk-embedded-backend-adapter -w @rubydogjp/openkk-browser-print-adapter -w @rubydogjp/openkk-browser-platform-adapter -w @rubydogjp/openkk-local-book-files-adapter -w @rubydogjp/openkk-cli -w @rubydogjp/openkk-client-browser
scripts.test:e2e:export: npm run build -w @rubydogjp/openkk-bundle-original && npm run test:e2e:export:built -- --project=original
